ValidationRule.description: Restrict INTL user from changing the status when the account's billing country is not equals AU and status is Assigned - Deal Support - Deal Sheet
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - Freight", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - QCC", $Profile.Name <> "Qantas System Admin - SND", $Profile.Name <> "CRM Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "CRM Administrator - Freight", $Profile.Name <> "CRM Administrator - Global", $Profile.Name <> "CRM Administrator - QCC", $Profile.Name <> "CRM Administrator - SND", Account.BillingCountry <> "AU", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Deal_Support_request", ISPICKVAL( Status , "Assigned - Deal Support - Deal Sheet") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Selected Case Status is not allowed. Please select a different Status.
